assumptions.choice: Used SMA 50 on the 1-minute data stream as a trend indicator filter.
assumptions.reason: The specification mentions using moving average direction (e.g. SMA 50) on a higher timeframe. Since execution environment provides a single 1m data feed, SMA 50 provides a practical trend slope check without warm-up exhaustion.

assumptions.choice: Defined impulse peak as the extreme price reached post-breakout until a counter bar appears, and reversal signal as a single candlestick closing in the trade direction while interacting with the 50%-61.8% Fibonacci zone.
assumptions.reason: The spec states to measure Fibonacci levels from the move after range breakout and enter when price reaches the golden zone and shows signs of reversal.

assumptions.choice: Calculated position size using 1% fixed portfolio risk based on distance to the defined stop-loss price.
assumptions.reason: The spec recommends fixed risk per trade (1-2% of capital) with stop-loss size defining risk.

assumptions.choice: Triggered immediate position exit when bar Close returns back inside the Opening Range boundary (Close < OR High for Long, Close > OR Low for Short).
assumptions.reason: The spec specifies an alternative exit upon a full return of the price back inside the initial range (ORB).
